# Vendored third-party code
- lightweight-charts 5.2.1 (TradingView, Apache-2.0): `lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js`, licence in
  `LIGHTWEIGHT-CHARTS-LICENSE.txt`. Fetched from the npm registry (`npm pack lightweight-charts@5.2.1`) on 2026-10-08.
  Attribution: the library README requires the NOTICE attribution plus a link to https://www.tradingview.com/ on the page.
  The npm package does NOT include a NOTICE file; we satisfy the link requirement with the chart option
  `attributionLogo: true` and show the credit "Charts: TradingView Lightweight Charts™ (Apache-2.0)" in the app footer.
